So 2025-12-31 is Wednesday + 364 days (52 weeks) = Wednesday. So 2025-12-31 is Wednesday. Then 2026-01-01 is Thursday. So 2026-01-01 is Thursday. Day 1 is Jan 1. So day 162 is June 11. Day 1 is Thursday. So day 162: 161 days after Jan 1. 161 mod 7 = 0? 161 / 7 = 23 remainder 0. So same weekday as Jan 1: Thursday. So June 11 is Thursday.
